definitions.explanation: Having extensive experience and refined skills acquired over many years; demonstrating the wisdom and competence of a veteran.

examples.japanese: {老練|ろうれん}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧だ。
{老練|ろうれん}な⟦{手腕|しゅわん}→手腕：07466_shuwan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: He overcame the crisis with his experienced skills.

examples.japanese: {老練|ろうれん}な⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧。
examples.english: A veteran lawyer with seasoned negotiation skills.

notes:
{老練|ろうれん} describes someone with extensive experience and refined skills.

FORMS:
- {老|ろう} (old, experienced) + {練|れん} (train, refine)
- Literally: refined through age/experience

USAGE:
{老練|ろうれん} emphasizes:
- Years of accumulated experience
- Skills honed through practice
- Wisdom gained from experience
- Reliable, dependable expertise

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老練|ろうれん}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: seasoned politician
- {老練|ろうれん}な⟦{手腕|しゅわん}→手腕：07466_shuwan⟧: experienced skill
- {老練|ろうれん}な⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: veteran technique

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧: skilled, proficient
- ⟦{円熟|えんじゅく}→円熟：09112_enjuku⟧: mature, mellow
- ⟦{練達|れんたつ}→練達：09113_rentatsu⟧: mastery, proficiency
